interface.shortDescription: A tiny arcade for while Codex works
interface.longDescription: Two developer games in one arcade, meant to be opened for a couple of minutes while a longer Codex task runs, then closed again. SHIP IT is a one-button endless runner: jump BUG, 404, MERGE CONFLICT and other developer disasters, chain PERFECT jumps into FLOW STATE, and rack up deployments — with a public global leaderboard. MERGE CONFLICT MINI GOLF is developer mini golf: nine handcrafted holes built from real dev concepts (BUG bumpers, 404 portals, CORS barriers, REBASE geometry, ROLLBACK and CACHE hazards) — get your commit into main. Both run entirely in the browser with no account needed; local high scores are stored on your device.
